# Hikanos Project

> A free, confidential 3-month cohort program for post-exit founders with $5m–$50m in liquid wealth: an independent financial plan, a personal "enough" level, and a plan to use the surplus for purpose. Run by Freddy Zwanzger (3× exited founder), based in Germany. Part of the "Surplus for Purpose" ecosystem with Original Position, Enough Project and Metron Advisory.

The whole site is one page; a clean Markdown copy is at /index.md.

## Page sections

- [Where you are as a post-exit founder](https://hikanos.org/#where-you-are): outside and inside situation after an exit
- [Why Hikanos?](https://hikanos.org/#why-hikanos): ἱκανός, Ancient Greek for sufficient, from the verb "to arrive"
- [What you can gain](https://hikanos.org/#what-you-gain): peers, financial planning without perverse incentives, a purpose for the surplus
- [How the program works](https://hikanos.org/#program): 6 online sessions over 3 months, at most 8 founders, completely free; core elements and program outline
- [What you take away](https://hikanos.org/#take-aways): your "enough" level, your financial plan, your plan for the surplus; full confidentiality
- [Who am I](https://hikanos.org/#about): Freddy Zwanzger
- [The "Surplus for Purpose" ecosystem](https://hikanos.org/#ecosystem): four programs for different wealth situations
- [Resources for post-exit founders](https://hikanos.org/#resources): podcast, Yale papers, book, financial calculators
- [Next steps](https://hikanos.org/#next-steps): apply, newsletter, contact
